title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten recurring UCF traditions documented on the university’s official traditions page, spanning welcome week, Homecoming, arts, service and campus gatherings.

cards.title: Start at Pegasus Palooza
cards.subtitle: UCF’s official fall Welcome Week
cards.notes: Check the current Pegasus Palooza schedule, then use its social, academic and service activities to get oriented during fall welcome week.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF identifies Pegasus Palooza as its official Welcome Week, held each fall with social, academic and service activities.
cards.access_notes: See the official event schedule for current dates, locations and participation details.

cards.title: Be Welcomed at The Knighting
cards.subtitle: New-Knight formal convocation
cards.notes: Attend if you are a new student and want the formal welcome that marks induction into UCF’s student community.
cards.short_summary: A formal convocation welcoming new UCF students.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF describes The Knighting as a formal convocation marking a student’s induction as an official UCF student.
cards.access_notes: Intended for new students; confirm current orientation programming and eligibility before attending.

cards.title: Charge into Spirit Splash
cards.subtitle: Homecoming at the Reflecting Pond
cards.notes: If participating, wear items that can get wet and follow event staff directions while joining the Homecoming pep rally at the pond.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming pond rush for collectible ducks and shirts.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says Spirit Splash is a Homecoming Week pep rally where Knights enter the Reflecting Pond for collectible rubber ducks and commemorative T-shirts.
cards.access_notes: Follow current Homecoming instructions and on-site safety guidance; conditions and access may change.

cards.title: Share Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: An annual UCF family tradition
cards.notes: Invite family to experience campus together, and confirm the current weekend’s registration, events and visitor guidance before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A campus tradition centered on students showing family around UCF.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF presents Family Weekend as a tradition for students to spend time with family and show them around campus.
cards.access_notes: Consult the current Family Weekend program for dates, registration requirements and individual event details.

cards.title: Keep Moving at Knight-Thon
cards.subtitle: Spring dance marathon for a local children’s hospital
cards.notes: Register through the current Knight-Thon organizers, wear comfortable shoes and participate in the spring dance marathon’s fundraising activities.
cards.short_summary: A spring dance-marathon tradition supporting a local children’s hospital.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF identifies Knight-Thon as a spring dance marathon that raises funds for a local children’s hospital.
cards.access_notes: Check Knight-Thon’s current registration, fundraising and event information before participating.

cards.title: Make Time for UCF Celebrates the Arts
cards.subtitle: Spring 10-day university arts festival
cards.notes: Browse the current festival program and choose a musical, living-art or concert performance that fits your schedule and access needs.
cards.short_summary: A 10-day festival showcasing UCF creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF describes UCF Celebrates the Arts as a 10-day festival featuring musicals, living art and concert performances.
cards.access_notes: Individual performances may have separate reservations or admission policies; consult the current festival program.

cards.title: Bring a Blanket to Symphony Under the Stars
cards.subtitle: Annual outdoor concert on Memory Mall
cards.notes: Pack a blanket and picnic, then check the current concert announcement for weather, timing and any site-specific visitor instructions.
cards.short_summary: An annual outdoor UCF Symphony Orchestra concert.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says Symphony Under the Stars is an annual outdoor Memory Mall concert performed by the UCF Symphony Orchestra.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and arrangements vary; verify the current announcement before traveling to Memory Mall.

cards.title: Take the Universal Knights Study Break
cards.subtitle: Spring access to Universal’s Islands of Adventure
cards.notes: Watch Student Government announcements for the current process and eligibility, then plan for the spring late-night park event with fellow Knights.
cards.short_summary: A spring UCF outing with exclusive late-night park access.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF states that Universal Knights gives thousands of Knights exclusive, late-night access to Universal’s Islands of Adventure each spring and is free.
cards.access_notes: UCF lists this as a spring event; confirm current Student Government eligibility, registration and transportation details.

cards.title: Pull Up a Chair at Gather Luncheon
cards.subtitle: Annual community meal on Memory Mall
cards.notes: Look for the annual event notice and reserve or arrive as instructed to join the community meal with other Knights on Memory Mall.
cards.short_summary: An annual community-building meal for hundreds of Knights.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says the annual Gather Luncheon brings 500 Knights together for a free, three-course meal focused on community building.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current date, location and any RSVP requirements through the official event announcement.

cards.title: See Student Research Week in Action
cards.subtitle: Spring undergraduate research showcase
cards.notes: Review the current Research Week calendar and choose a workshop or showcase event to see undergraduate research presented on campus.
cards.short_summary: A spring week of workshops and undergraduate research events.
cards.evidence_claim: UCF says the Showcase of Undergraduate Research Excellence is part of Student Research Week, which hosts workshops and events in early April.
cards.access_notes: Check the current Research Week calendar for event format, venue and any required registration.
